readings.Aries: The desire you've been intellectualising has a body. Let it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Taurus: Someone around you is moving faster than you're comfortable with. Your pace is not wrong. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Gemini: The idea you abandoned is still good. Pick it up again. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Cancer: The person you've been nurturing needs you to need them back. Allow it. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Leo: The dignity you carry is real and sometimes it makes you harder to reach. Lower the threshold slightly. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Virgo: You notice what others miss. This is a gift. It is also an exhausting way to move through the world. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Libra: You are allowed to have a preference. Having one does not make you unfair. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Scorpio: You are more forgiving than your reputation suggests. One person knows this. Let a second. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you've been calling freedom is starting to look like avoidance from a certain angle. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Capricorn: Something you've built together with someone else is worth tending to. Not as a project. As a relationship. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Aquarius: There is a feeling underneath the analysis that the analysis is a way of not feeling. Set the analysis down briefly. The first instinct was right.
readings.Pisces: The boundary you need to draw will feel unkind. It isn't. It is necessary. Saying less will move this further than saying more.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
